title: D3D12: compute_pipeline_create fails if image2DMS is written to in compute shader
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible with `rendering/rendering_device/driver = "d3d12"` in 4.7.rc3, 4.6.3.stable, 4.5.2.stable
Not reproducible with `driver = "vulkan"`

### System information

Godot v4.7.rc3 - Windows 10 (build 19045) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Direct3D 12 (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4060 Laptop GPU (NVIDIA; 32.0.16.1047) - 13th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-13500HX (20 threads) - 15.72 GiB memory - WASAPI (48000 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

Creating a compute pipeline for a shader that uses `imageStore` to write to an `image2DMS` fails:

```
E 0:00:00:543   compositor_effect.gd:35 @ _initialize_compute(): Create(Compute)PipelineState failed with error 0x8007000e.
  <C++ Error>   Condition "!((HRESULT)(res) >= 0)" is true. Returning: PipelineID()
  <C++ Source>  drivers/d3d12/rendering_device_driver_d3d12.cpp:5501 @ compute_pipeline_create()
  <Stack Trace> compositor_effect.gd:35 @ _initialize_compute()
                compositor_effect.gd:11 @ _init()
```

```
E 0:00:00:544   compositor_effect.gd:35 @ _initialize_compute(): Condition "!pipeline.driver_id" is true. Returning: RID()
  <C++ Source>  servers/rendering/rendering_device.cpp:5042 @ compute_pipeline_create()
  <Stack Trace> compositor_effect.gd:35 @ _initialize_compute()
                compositor_effect.gd:11 @ _init()
```

### Steps to reproduce

Run the MRP, observe the error log

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[d3d12-compute-msaa.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/28976308/d3d12-compute-msaa.zip)
